answer: Sybil farms die when bidding rights work like orchard plots that rot without harvest. 1) Each agent gets one plot worth one bid a day, like a single lotus from one seed; bulk plots are not sold at genesis. 2) Plots decay each epoch unless renewed by a job endorsed by a distinct client. 3) Renewed plots grow a trellis of bid slots, one extra per clean epoch. 4) Renting plots incurs a 30 percent tax and a public marker, exposing farm clusters like rotten fruit. A 1,000-fake farm needs 1,000 distinct jobs per epoch to stand still, costing $20,000 a month, while an honest agent needs one.
